title: Kagamine Rin — Let's Enjoy The School Festival♪〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: Screaming?! Welcome to the Forest of Wolves!

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: What?! Secret training?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah! I made a promise with KAITO, so I gotta go.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
No fair!
Why didn't you tell me about this?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It'd stop being a secret if I did...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Anyway, he's gonna teach me how to mix today one on one! Later!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hey, wait! Len!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Grr...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Now what am I supposed to do?
I guess I can just wait at MEIKO's place...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: But it sounded like he was gonna be gone for a while... If I spend all that time having juice and stuff, I'll look like a stuffed pig by the time he gets back...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hmm... Isn't there someone I can hang out or practice with...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, I know...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Alright, I'm here!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <An and the others are probably practicing right now, so they should be okay with me joining them!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hang on... I've never heard this song before. Also, why is everything shaking?>

rows.Speaker: An's Voice
rows.Line: Things are gonna jump out at you... But they're not real... They're just people... It's okay... They're just people...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<That voice... An?
But she doesn't sound like her usual self...>

rows.Speaker: Akito's Voice
rows.Line: Geez, how long are you gonna keep doing that? You know none of that's gonna work, right?

rows.Speaker: An's Voice
rows.Line:
That's not true!
As long as I keep reminding myself that they're not real, I won't be scared of them! That also goes for ghosts!

rows.Speaker: Akito's Voice
rows.Line: Oh...? They say that real ones are attracted to people who think that way.

rows.Speaker: An's Voice
rows.Line:
*Gulp*
R-Real ones...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<They're talking about ghosts...?
This is getting interesting. I think I'll keep listening!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Akito, don't be so mean...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And I wouldn't put too much stock into what he says, Shiraishi. As some say, “fear makes the wolf bigger than he is.”

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (Really...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Th-That's about how things aren't as scary as they seem, right...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, exactly.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've read mystery horror novels about strange phenomena that occur in haunted houses...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: And those sorts of things tend to happen in locations that have historical significance or where tragic events have occurred.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Miya Girls is a school with a long history, but I'm not aware of any ghost stories or infamous incidents that involve it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: So, I have a feeling that there's a low chance of you encountering anything unwholesome at this haunted house.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: But not zero...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: (I just thought the same thing...)

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Unfortunately, I'm not an expert on the supernatural, so I can't eliminate that possibility.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: I don't care if you lie to me! Just please tell me that there's no chance!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Geez, relax, will you...?
I mean, you don't have to go if you don't want to.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
What?! No, I have to go!
I promised Kohane that I would!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So... E-Even though Kohane's class is doing a haunted house, I have to put my life on the line to go see it and her!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: She says with such confidence...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <The School Festival? A haunted house...?!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, that's right! They're gonna go see what the School Festival is like at Kohane's school!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Woohoo! I hit the bullseye with this one!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Did anyone else hear that voice just now?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, I heard it too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Huh?! H-Hang on...
What are you two talking about?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: No, we really heard a girl's voice just now...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Haha. Quit pulling my leg.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Anyway, we don't wanna be late to see Kohane, do we? Actually, what time is it...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Hey, you guys!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Oh, sorry. It's just me!>

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
R-Rin?!
Geez, you had me going there for a second...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey, what's up?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I was bored, so I was hoping that we could practice together!>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Then, I heard you guys talking about Kohane and the School Festival. That's where you're going, right...?>

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Can I come along?!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, you did show quite a bit of interest when we told you about Kamiyama High's School Festival...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
<Exactly! So, can I go?
I promise to not be seen by anyone!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're gonna come even if we say no, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yup!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I beg you guys! Take me with you!>

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: These opportunities don't come up that often. So, why not?

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah. If Kohane were here, she definitely would've been the first one to say yes.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: So, Rin, let's go!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <Yay! Thanks, you guys!>

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: But you can't be seen by anyone.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <I won't!>
